notes: Style v2 player health: small straight marks (5x5, lower-right corner clipped) in the dried-rose ui.health ramp; an empty mark is the same footprint carved into the plate (ink top/left wall, plate floor, ash lower-right lip), so it reads as a hole. The 15x14 cell leaves room for the 'lose' chips. Anchor = the mark's top-left pixel: draw mark i at (x0 + 8*i, y0) on a slate #303949 plate. Play 'lose' once on a mark that empties (bone flash, split along the cut, chips fall away), 'gain' on one that fills, then hold 'full'/'empty'. UI layer, unlit, no glow.
